purpose: a city inside a country is not a physical inconsistency; a required spatial hierarchy is unsupported_location_granularity without dropping a level
text: Ann is a person. Ann is in Tallinn. Ann is in Estonia. Tallinn is in Estonia. There is a ferry from Tallinn to Helsinki.

compile.detail: a located_at target (Tallinn) is itself located in another located_at target (Estonia) of the same actor: two spatial levels

units.note: place containment is written as located_at of a place in a place, an explicit input of this unsupported test (REVIEW.md disposition 3); it is not a general rule for English 'in' and is distinct from the physical container relation in. The compiler must detect the nesting whatever the form.

explain: Fable addenda point 10 with Astra's remedy: not a containment exception in the consistency check, but a granularity diagnostic when the source states two levels for one actor. The base text states the nesting, so the route reports it. The unstated_hierarchy variant records what v1 does when the nesting is not stated: the same diagnostic, because exclusivity is checked only within a declared flat set (c09). The ferry sentence is a unit in every source; the base is not trimmed.
